ios.desc:
Play-ya List is a smart playlist app for you to discover your music by setting your own rules. Yep, that’s right. You. Set. Rules.

What some examples? Here you go:
• songs longer then 30 minutes
• what I haven’t listened for last 3 months
• my all-time top 20 (5, 100, whatever number you want!) hits
• songs I skipped last year

You may want to start with the Play-ya lists we’ve put together for you to get the feeling of how the app works. After that, there’s really no limits for you to set up the rules and create your unique playlists. 

Our machine learning algorithm analyses your music habits and helps you discover the music your way. Play-ya is all about your individuality, your uniqueness. 

Play-ya Lists are being updated on the go when you listen to the music. They are really live.

Enjoy!
